description: Spaarndammerbuurt (BAG 1933), Houtrijkstraat 381-383, Polanenstraat 222-224, Hembrugstraat 21-27: a 12.6 m plain brown brick portiek front of four storeys, a wide white-framed window either side of a staircase axis; on the axis a 0.5 m glass-block ladder light (white bars every 0.65 m) from the door canopy to just under the eaves, over a double portiek door under a white slab canopy; a deep white flat-roof overhang along the whole row

overhang.note: the row's deep flat-roof overhang: wall top 12.45 m (Houtrijkstraat 381 strip), a white ribbed soffit and a 0.4 m white fascia; chimney stacks stand on the roof behind

door-centre.note: the double portiek door on the staircase axis (rectified 1.5-1.9 m wide), under a 3 m white slab canopy at 2.7-2.9 m

match.note: the 1933 rows with a ladder staircase light; the 15.4 m five-axis fronts of the same rows (Houtrijkstraat 399-401, Polanenstraat 240-242) are another design

rhythm.bays: a wide window either side of a staircase axis
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: window + door + window | 1-3: 2 wide windows and the ladder light
rhythm.symmetry: near-symmetric about the staircase axis; the next pand repeats it
rhythm.groundFloor: double portiek door under a white slab canopy
rhythm.roofline: deep white flat-roof overhang along the row
